dialogs.title: Welcome to Juniper Canopy
dialogs.text: Welcome to Juniper CanopyJuniper Canopy is a real-time monitoring dashboard for Cascade Correlation Neural Network training. Here's how to get started:Configure parameters in the sidebar (or use defaults)Click Start to begin trainingWatch metrics, topology, and decision boundaries update liveSave snapshots to checkpoint your progressSee the Tutorial tab for a complete reference guide.Get Started
